{{Quote|I knew you would prove your worth as a ''Security Advisor'' when I asked Captain Typho to take you along.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|<ref name="Too Many Cooks">{{SWComicCite|7.4|Too Many Cooks}}</ref>}}
'''Security Advisor''' was a position briefly occupied by [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], when he served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] at the [[Naboo Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
